name: book-workflow
description: 知识蒸馏工作流：重建书中思想、叙事与口吻，核查来源，构建候选并验证真实回答后交付；程序能力继续经仓颉与四闸核验。机械检查在本地执行，语义评审与行为试答由宿主模型或人工完成。

description_i18n.en: Distill a book into source-grounded thinking, narrative voice and worked applications. Build private candidates, evaluate actual answers, then publish the tested payload. Procedural capabilities retain cangjie and the four local gates; semantic review and behavior tests use the host model or human reviewers.
